explication: Claude-Codex Skills is a catalog of independently usable agent skills, distributed in eight plugins. A user chooses a task, installs and invokes a suitable skill, and receives a bounded work product such as a decision, plan, change, review, or diagnosis. README describes a broader lifecycle from discovery through operations, with feedback into product and architecture work; it also says skill maintenance supports the collection. The graph reflects those documented relationships, not internal skill execution, which was not sampled.
